title: Automattic Launches Spacefast for Vibe Coding Deployment
summary: Automattic debuts Spacefast, a platform for deploying vibe-coded apps with infrastructure, databases, and authentication. Competes with Lovable and Emergent.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Automattic launched Spacefast, a deployment platform for vibe-coded apps with built-in infrastructure, databases, and authentication
- The platform integrates with ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other AI coding agents while competing with Lovable and Emergent
- Spacefast aims to consolidate IT sprawl for enterprises using WordPress infrastructure and WooCommerce integration


Automattic, the company behind WordPress.com, has officially launched Spacefast, a deployment platform designed specifically for[vibe-coded applications](https://emergent.sh/learn/what-is-vibe-coding) . Officially launched on November 9, 2026, the service provides infrastructure including databases, authentication, file uploads, email services, and analytics to transform AI-generated code into fully functional websites and applications.


## What Spacefast Offers Developers


Spacefast positions itself as an open infrastructure layer for[vibe coding](https://emergent.sh/glossary/what-is-vibe-coding) projects. Unlike all-in-one platforms, it allows developers to connect their preferred[AI coding agents](https://emergent.sh/glossary/agentic-coding) , including ChatGPT, Claude, Hermes, OpenClaw, Grokbot, Muse, Pi, Cursor, Opencode, and Amp. Users can also link Git repositories directly to the platform to begin deployment.


The product head, Batuhan Icoz, developed the initial concept during an Automattic hackathon sprint earlier in 2026 while working on the company's Beeper messaging app. He observed non-technical friends sharing Vercel links for vibe coding projects and recognized a gap in the deployment process. The team soft-launched the platform in September 2026 before today's public release.


## Competition in the Vibe Coding Space


Spacefast enters a crowded market that includes Lovable and Emergent, which offer combined interface and infrastructure solutions. Design tools like Figma, Canva, and Notion have also launched products targeting the intersection of vibe coding, mockups, and presentations.


According to Icoz, Spacefast's competitive advantage lies in its flexibility. While competitors provide end-to-end solutions, Spacefast gives users choice over their AI agent and deployment workflow. The platform also leverages Automattic's existing infrastructure, including web analytics, WordPress integration, and WooCommerce e-commerce capabilities.


- Agent-agnostic infrastructure supporting multiple AI coding tools
- Direct Git repository integration for version control
- Built-in CDN leveraging Automattic's infrastructure
- Enterprise-focused consolidation for IT sprawl reduction
- Native WordPress and WooCommerce integration roadmap


## Enterprise Focus and Use Cases


Early adopters have used Spacefast for internal mockups, slideshows, and promotional websites. The platform targets enterprises struggling with IT sprawl as marketing teams generate landing pages across multiple vibe coding services. Automattic's experience serving enterprise customers through WordPress positions Spacefast as a consolidation solution.


Icoz acknowledged the retention challenge facing new AI products, noting that users often experiment with new tools before moving to the next innovation. The team's strategy focuses on making Spacefast so seamless that results significantly outperform manual deployment alternatives.


## Launch Context and Industry Shift


The launch occurs as traditional web publishing faces pressure from AI chatbots and summaries that reduce direct website traffic. Google recently reported declining ad revenue growth, reflecting this shift in user behavior. Icoz acknowledged that many developers now create websites through ChatGPT or Claude rather than deploying on WordPress, suggesting some sites may not need traditional content management systems as the web evolves.


Spacefast arrives during turbulent months at Automattic, which experienced executive changes, board restructuring, and layoffs across several properties in October 2026. The company's CEO Matt Mullenweg was temporarily ousted by the board before returning to control within days, followed by interim CFO departure and additional organizational changes.


## What This Means


Automattic's Spacefast represents a strategic pivot for the WordPress ecosystem toward AI-native development workflows. By providing infrastructure rather than attempting to compete on the coding interface itself, the platform acknowledges that vibe coding has matured beyond experimental demos into production-ready applications. For enterprises managing multiple AI-generated properties, Spacefast offers a consolidation path that leverages familiar WordPress infrastructure while supporting modern development practices. The platform's success will depend on its ability to retain users beyond initial experimentation and demonstrate measurable advantages over integrated alternatives.
